path_decisions.rationale: No trailing stop exists in any strategy template — exits only on trend-reversal. Early profit-taking via triple-barrier is the highest-impact win-rate lever
Entry AND-logic at trend_following.py:239 requires 5 simultaneous conditions — too restrictive, producing few trades. Relaxing to N-of-M increases trade frequency and win-rate sampling

ATR cap (atr < atr_cap where atr_cap = atr_ma * atr_multiplier=2.0) at trend_following.py:152 blocks entries during volatile regimes, but volatile regimes often have the best trend moves. Reducing multiplier from 2.0 to 1.5 allows more trend entries
All changes need validation — current gate defaults to Sharpe objective (gate.py:41) which conflicts with win-rate targeting

candidate_solution.summary: 4 changes: (1) add trailing-stop/early-exit to strategy templates, (2) relax AND-entry to N-of-M, (3) tune ATR multiplier, (4) add win_rate to validation

change_1.title: Add ATR-based trailing stop and profit-target exit to all strategy templates
change_1.current: Exit only on full trend-reversal signal — no trailing stop, no profit target. Winning trades often give back significant open profit before reversal is detected.
change_1.proposed: Add trailing_stop_atr_multiplier (default=2.5) and profit_take_pct (default=0.08) params. In generate_signals(), after computing boolean exits, also mark bars as exit when: (a) price drops below trailing stop = highest_since_entry - ATR * multiplier, or (b) unrealized profit >= profit_take_pct. Wire triple_barrier_labels from barriers.py as helper.
change_1.rationale: The single biggest win-rate lever. Currently trades are held until trend reversal, meaning many 'winning' trades become 'losing' trades as price reverses. A trailing stop locks in partial profits. A profit target converts marginal winners into guaranteed winners. This directly increases win_rate without requiring entry filter changes.

change_2.title: Wire triple-barrier method into strategy templates
change_2.current: triple_barrier_labels() exists and computes profit-take/stop-loss/time-barrier labels, but is NOT called by any strategy template or the backtest engine.
change_2.proposed: Add max_holding_bars parameter (default=20) to all strategy templates. In generate_signals(), mark exits for any entry where max_holding_bars has elapsed without hitting entry-exit logic. This uses the time-barrier from barriers.py. Combined with profit_take_pct, gives full triple-barrier exit system.
change_2.rationale: Time-based exit prevents holding stale positions that drift from entry thesis. Combined with profit_target and stop_loss, this is the full triple-barrier method that de Prado recommends. Directly reduces the number of trades that flip from win to loss due to holding too long.

change_3.title: Add min_conditions parameter for N-of-M entry logic
change_3.current: entries = trend_up & rsi_ok_long & vol_ok & atr_ok — ALL 5 conditions required simultaneously
change_3.proposed: Add min_conditions param (default=5 for backward compat, set to 4 for win-rate optimization). Compute condition_count = trend_up.astype(int) + rsi_ok_long.astype(int) + vol_ok.astype(int) + atr_ok.astype(int) + (macd_hist > 0).astype(int). entries = condition_count >= min_conditions. Same pattern for mean_reversion (3 conditions) and volatility_breakout (5 conditions).
change_3.rationale: 5-way AND produces extremely few signals in crypto where conditions rarely all align. Requiring 4-of-5 produces 2-3x more signals while each individual filter still contributes quality. More trades with directional bias = higher win rate sampling.

change_4.title: Reduce ATR multiplier from 2.0 to make volatility filter less restrictive
change_4.current: atr_multiplier=2.0 — ATR cap filter requires ATR < 2 * ATR_ma, blocking entries during elevated volatility which is often where the best trends occur
change_4.proposed: Lower default atr_multiplier to 1.5 and include it in param_space for Optuna search with range [1.2, 2.5]. This allows entries during moderately elevated volatility when trends are strongest, while still blocking extreme volatility regimes.
change_4.rationale: The ATR cap was designed to avoid choppy markets, but in crypto, elevated ATR often coincides with strong trends. The current 2x cap is too conservative and filters out many good trend entries. Reducing to 1.5 allows more entries during trend initiation phases.

notes: Key finding: no strategy template has ANY form of trailing stop or profit target. The entire exit logic is reversal-signal-only. This is the dominant win-rate issue — trades that were profitable at some point become losses because exit only triggers on reversal. The triple-barrier method in barriers.py is fully implemented but completely unused.
